correctness.rationale: Signed inclusion-exclusion over vertices and factorization over E(K_n[T]) give W_n(H)=(-1)^n sum_{S independent in H}(-1)^|S|2^(choose(|S|,2)). Reduction modulo two gives W=(-1)^n(1-n), hence even-n invertibility and odd-n evenness; removing a matching of a edges from K_n gives independent-set polynomial 1+nt+at^2 and witness W=(-1)^n(1-n+2a), yielding gap 1 or 2 and odd-n zero at the stated a. Modulo four, only independent sets of size <=2 matter, and toggling a fixed H-edge pairs exactly half the odd-n frequencies with valuation one. Independently computed the full 2^21 coefficient transform via an integer subset-zeta algorithm: n=7 has 73115 zeros, positive rank 2024037, minimum magnitude 2, and exactly 1048576 coefficients with two-adic valuation one. The supplied 39 seven-vertex graph6 orbit rows and weight column sum to the zero total, and the proof of exact all-order gaps is separate from the finite census.
residual_risks: The orbit census is a finite computational certificate, not a closed general odd-order nullity formula.
External verification of the graph6 automorphism class enumeration was limited to inspecting the listed 39 orbit rows and totals; full independent graph-isomorphism atlas reconstruction was not run.
